name: Creamy Mushroom Turkey Meatball Skillet
why: In-lane stovetop turkey meatballs: meatballs are seared in the skillet then simmered in a mushroom cream sauce (no oven). Site card publishes 500 cal/serving with a Low Carb badge; structurally very low-carb (turkey meatballs + mushrooms + heavy cream + parmesan, no starch) so ~9g carb estimate clears the 35g ceiling comfortably. Lands mid-band on calories. Source blends ground turkey with ground chicken - REBUILD to all ground turkey (ground chicken is a standing no and has no board home). Scales to 14 servings as a batch of meatballs plus sauce.
ingredients: 4 cloves garlic, grated + 4 cloves garlic, minced
1/2 teaspoon red crushed chili pepper flakes, optional
Salt and fresh cracked black pepper, to taste
nutrition_note: Calories (500) and 'Low Carb' label are from eatwell101's recipe card; the page's beta nutrition table does not publish a numeric carb value, so src_carbs is a structural estimate. Confidence on calories: medium-high; on exact carbs: structural (high that it is <35g). Rebuild the ground-chicken half onto ground turkey.
unmapped: shredded mozzarella (no dairy-mozzarella board home; only generic shredded-cheese or vegan daiya on the board)
